title: Output Conformance Gatekeeper for A/B Experiments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a lightweight, runtime gatekeeper that evaluates structured-output and function-call compatibility across A/B experiments and shadow traffic. The gatekeeper will run per-route conformance checks (schema validation, required/optional field diffs, function-call argument shape), compute a numeric compatibility score using deterministic heuristics plus a learned diff scorer, and emit a pass/fail decision to the rollout controller. It should support soft-fail reporting for early experiments and hard auto-rollback when critical invariants are violated. This ticket covers the engineering implementation (runtime validator, telemetry hooks, rollback integration) and end-to-end test harness for A/B and shadow rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper binary accepted by runtime and callable from rollout controller (REST endpoint + internal RPC).
Per-route validators configurable with JSON schema + field-level severity (required|warning|info).
Compatibility score computed for each request and surfaceable in telemetry (0-100).
A/B experiment control plane can set thresholds: report-only, soft-fail (do not rollback), hard-fail (trigger auto-rollback).
Integration tests exercising synthetic "golden prompts" for 10+ critical routes complete and pass in CI.
End-to-end canary where A gets 10% traffic, B gets 10% shadowed traffic and gatekeeper blocks promotion if critical regressions exceed threshold for 30m window.

tradeoffs_decisions: Strict schema enforcement reduces regression risk but increases false positives on models that intentionally change shape (trade: precision vs agility). Chosen hybrid scoring to allow configurable strictness per-route.
Learned diff scorer improves signal on semantic changes but needs training data and may be opaque — we cap its weight and require deterministic checks for required fields.
Real-time validation adds ~2-6ms median latency in the hot path. Adopted option to run full checks in shadow pipeline and a fast path validator for latency-sensitive routes.
Auto-rollback thresholds are conservative: require sustained anomaly window and operator confirmation for high-impact routes to avoid flapping.
testing_plan: Unit tests for schema loader, fuzzy function-call matcher, and numeric score calculator.
Integration tests in CI that spin up a local rollout controller and inject synthetic A/B traffic with golden prompts (see tests/golden_prompts/*.json in repo).
Canary on internal org: 10% A real traffic, 10% B shadowed; run for 48 hours with automated alerts if compatibility score drops below threshold.
Chaos test: simulate upstream model change that drops a required field and assert auto-rollback triggers (in staging only).
Regression-suite: run against backlog of historical requests to measure false positive rate (goal <2% for critical routes).
rollout_plan: Phase 0 — Shadow-only: add gatekeeper to shadow sink for target routes; collect baseline scores for 72h.
Phase 1 — Soft A/B: enable scoring and report-only for an A/B experiment (10% A, 10% B shadow). Notify owners on deviations.
Phase 2 — Thresholded canary: set hard-fail for low-risk routes with auto-rollback enabled; keep higher-risk routes in soft-fail.
Phase 3 — Promote: if 48h window shows no critical regressions and reliability metrics stable, promote model variant and remove shadowing.
Operator controls: console toggle to disable auto-rollback per-route and manual rollback button with audit entry.
monitoring_thresholds: Critical invariants (missing required fields): trigger immediate alert and increment hard-fail counter.
Compatibility score < 65 for >5% of sampled requests in 30m window => PagerDuty (P1) for high-impact routes.
Compatibility score drop of >20 points vs baseline median => create automated incident and mark canary as unhealthy.
False positive metric: fraction of gatekeeper failures overturned by human review; target <2% for promoted routes.
rollback_policy: Hard-fail: immediate rollback if critical invariant violated on >0.5% of traffic for 3 consecutive 5m buckets (staging: auto; prod: auto + notify).
Soft-fail: block promotion and create ticket; no automatic rollback.
Operator override available for maintenance windows with mandatory audit log entry.
Rollback must run compatible fallback model variant or route traffic to previous stable model version; ensure KV cache warming plan to avoid cold-start regressions.
